title: Avoid full-frame redraws for plugin status-only updates
description:
## Finding

Plugin status updates set broad dirty flags (`dirty` plus `bars_dirty`), forcing full-frame work even when only a bounded bar segment changed. High-frequency plugins can degrade responsiveness and output volume.

## Evidence at audited commit

`crates/thegn-host/src/run.rs:11347` and `crates/thegn-host/src/render_plan.rs:135`.

## Implementation constraints

Translate plugin cache mutations into the narrowest render damage region while preserving layout invalidation when size/placement actually changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Content-only status changes redraw only their owned bar/region.
- [ ] Add/remove/resize/theme/layout events still trigger the necessary broader invalidation.
- [ ] Repeated identical updates generate no frame.
- [ ] Update frequency remains bounded by plugin policy and compositor coalescing.
- [ ] Instrumentation tests compare damaged rows/bytes for status-only versus structural updates.

## Execution dependencies

Blocked by THE-165, THE-161 (both UNLANDED).
